extra.final_summary:
Data quality issues found and addressed for the average body mass by species question:

- body_mass_g out of range: 3 rows (22, 28, 49) with values 5,050,000 and 4,050,000 g, exceeding the rules range 2500-6500 g. These rows were excluded.
- sex label variants: rows 10 and 46 had leading/trailing spaces (" male", "male "). Normalized to canonical "male".
- flipper_length_mm has 3 negative values (rows 9, 16, 19) out of allowed 170-235 mm. This column is not used for the requested metric, so it was left as-is.

After cleaning, 50 rows remain. Average body mass per species:
- Adelie: 3,666.67 g
- Chinstrap: 3,801.79 g
- Gentoo: 5,173.33 g

Caveat: flipper_length_mm still contains impossible negative values; they do not affect the body mass average but would need fixing for any flipper-related analysis.
